t: This is John Smith House, at 144 to 152 Walworth Road, which was the headquarters of the Labour Party. The party moved in during 1980, after leaving its earlier home at Transport House. The building is named after John Smith, a Scottish politician who was Member of Parliament for Monklands East. He led the Labour Party, and served as Leader of the Opposition, from July 1992 until his death in May 1994. The party headquarters has since moved on, so the name is now the main reminder of that period.
